base.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photographic transparent PNG sprite for an augmented-reality costume. Generate one authentic-looking SOUTHERN CHINESE FUT SAN lion dance head, directly front facing and bilaterally balanced, photographed as an actual hand-crafted bamboo-and-rice-paper performance prop, not illustration, not cartoon, not a computer-rendered toy. A sculpted high forehead with ONE single central pointed horn at the top (not two horns), small round forehead mirror, oversized mechanical circular concentric eyes ringed with dense soft ivory wool, upright furry ears at the sides, curved expressive lips and a hinged open mouth with realistic ivory teeth. Rich cinnabar red painted/lacquered panels, carefully painted gold scroll motifs, gold foil glitter and fine sequins with authentic craft irregularity, ivory wool eyebrow and muzzle trim. A short ivory beard under the chin, with wispy individual fibres. Real dimensional materials, convincing studio product photography, soft diffuse frontal lighting with mild upper-left highlights; no cast shadow onto background. The entire lion head including horn, side ears and short beard is visible, centered tightly with only a narrow transparent margin. Head only: NO human, NO human head, NO skin, NO mannequin, NO body, NO neck, NO collar cape, NO hands. The head will be positioned ABOVE a real person's forehead so the face remains visible: it must be a self-contained compact prop with no trailing cloth below the short beard. Output one 1024x1024 image with a genuinely transparent alpha background, no checkerboard baked into the image, no labels, no text, no watermark.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photographic transparent PNG outfit sprite for real-time body-tracked augmented reality. A coordinated red and gold SOUTHERN CHINESE LION DANCE PERFORMANCE OUTFIT photographed straight-on on an invisible ghost mannequin, FRONT VIEW, centered, symmetric. The outfit is a real tailored martial-arts performance uniform inspired by southern lion dance: a cinnabar-red satin upper jacket with an OPEN wide rounded neckline with a small V opening (transparent inside the neckline), gold embroidered swirling cloud and wave ornament, small gold Chinese frog fastenings, ivory wool fur shoulder trim, and layered fluffy ivory fur scalloped strips at the waist. Matching loose red satin trousers with gold scroll embroidery and multiple plush ivory wool scalloped horizontal bands down the legs, as worn by southern lion dance performers. Two full long sleeves extend straight HORIZONTALLY left and right into a T pose, relaxed rounded construction, cuffs richly trimmed in ivory wool; the shoulder-to-hip torso is clearly distinct from the sleeves. The trouser legs point straight down and are separated by a transparent gap; both ankles end in ivory fur-trim cuffs. Include only the garment, fully visible with narrow transparent margins, no body inside. Very realistic textile photography: dense wool fibres, satin reflections, seams, embroidered thread relief, gold sequins, natural fabric folds and craftsmanship. The jacket and trousers form one coordinated floating outfit with a small waist overlap. Soft studio lighting matching a cinnabar/gold lion head, no backdrop shadow. This is garment texture for deformation around a live person's torso and limbs; preserve clear open neck, wrist and ankle openings. Output one 1024x1536 portrait image on a genuinely transparent alpha background. NO lion head, NO human, NO human face/head/neck, NO skin, NO hands, NO feet, NO visible mannequin, NO hanger, NO cape rectangle, NO illustration, NO line art, NO 3D cartoon, NO writing or watermark.
base.backgroundExtractionNote: A built-in image_gen background-extraction edit was applied after generation, preserving the garment, palette, silhouette, and embroidery and requesting zero-alpha pixels outside the clothes and inside the neck/leg gaps.
